startUrls.title: Start URLs (accepts Jobs and Companies URLs)
startUrls.description:
Any YC URL. Auto-routed by path. Mix Jobs and Companies URLs freely. The two URLs prefilled below are sample defaults — clear them and paste your own when running.

**Jobs URLs:**
- `https://www.ycombinator.com/jobs` (curated index)
- `https://www.ycombinator.com/jobs/role/{role}` (e.g. `…/jobs/role/software-engineer`)
- `https://www.ycombinator.com/jobs/role/{role}/{location}` (e.g. `…/jobs/role/

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Pick a target surface; the matching filter fields below will be used. Jobs uses the role/location selectors; Companies uses the keyword/batch/industry/region/size block.

role.title: 💼 Jobs · Role
role.description: Used when Mode = Jobs and Start URLs is empty. YC role category.

location.title: 💼 Jobs · Location
location.description: Used when Mode = Jobs. City slugs match the city name in each job's location string; `remote` matches anything containing 'Remote'; `india` matches the country.

queries.title: 🏢 Companies · Search Keywords
queries.description: Used when Mode = Companies. One or more keywords (product category, market, technology, location, …). Multiple keywords run as separate Algolia searches and are merged by company id with dedupe. Empty = no keyword filter.

topCompany.title: 🏢 Companies · Include Top Companies Only
topCompany.description: Limit results to companies marked as Top by Y Combinator. Use when you want a smaller, more selective set.

isHiring.title: 🏢 Companies · Include Hiring Companies Only
isHiring.description: Limit results to companies currently marked as hiring. Useful for recruiting and active-growth research.

nonprofit.title: 🏢 Companies · Include Nonprofit Companies Only
nonprofit.description: Limit results to companies marked as nonprofits. Leave disabled to include both commercial and nonprofit organizations.

batch.title: 🏢 Companies · YC Batches
batch.description: Select one or more batches to narrow results by cohort.

industries.title: 🏢 Companies · Industries
industries.description: Select one or more industries to focus the run.

regions.title: 🏢 Companies · HQ Regions
regions.description: Select one or more regions to narrow geographically.

minEmployeeSize.title: 🏢 Companies · Minimum Employee Size
minEmployeeSize.description: Smallest team size to include. Select '1+' for no minimum.

maxEmployeeSize.title: 🏢 Companies · Maximum Employee Size
maxEmployeeSize.description: Largest team size to include. Select '1000+' for no maximum.

scrapeFounderDetails.title: 🙌 Companies Enrich · Scrape Founder Details
scrapeFounderDetails.description: Companies mode only. Adds an extra HTTP per company (concurrency = 5) — slows runs. Fetches `/companies/{slug}` and adds `founders[]` (name, title, bio, linkedinUrl, twitterUrl, avatarUrl, isActive, hasEmail) plus `socials` (linkedin, twitter, facebook, crunchbase, github), `appVideoUrl`, `demoDayVideoUrl`.

scrapeOpenJobs.title: 🙌 Companies Enrich · Scrape Open Job Postings
scrapeOpenJobs.description: Companies mode only. Adds an extra HTTP per company (concurrency = 5) — slows runs. Fetches `/companies/{slug}/jobs` and adds `openJobs[]` (title, role, location, salary, equity, experience, applyUrl, posted-ago).

enrichEmails.title: Enrich with contact emails (experimental)
enrichEmails.description: If enabled, finds a contact email for each result from its own website (or by discovering it from the name). Adds contactEmail + contactWebsite columns plus a detailed emailEnrichment object. Best-effort.

maxItems.title: Max items per URL
maxItems.description: **Per-URL cap.** Each entry in Start URLs (Option A) and each filter run (Option B) gets its own quota of this many records. Pasting 3 URLs with `maxItems=100` returns up to 300 rows total (100 per URL). Free-tier accounts are capped at 100 per URL regardless.

monitoringMode.title: Monitoring mode (jobs only)
monitoringMode.description: Jobs scraper only: only jobs whose numeric id has not been stored in your Key-Value store yet are enqueued (per Apify user id). Useful for scheduled runs that should only emit new postings.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency (jobs only)
maxConcurrency.description: Jobs scraper only: max parallel HTTP requests.

minConcurrency.title: Min concurrency (jobs only)
minConcurrency.description: Jobs scraper only: min parallel HTTP requests to keep active.

maxRequestRetries.title: Max request retries (jobs only)
maxRequestRetries.description: Jobs scraper only: retries before a request is marked failed.

proxy.title: Proxy configuration (jobs only)
proxy.description: Proxy for the Jobs scraper. Companies mode hits YC's Algolia API directly and does not use a proxy regardless of what's configured here.

startUrls.title: YC Directory or Company URLs
startUrls.description: Paste one or more Y Combinator URLs. Accepts directory pages with filters pre-applied (e.g. https://www.ycombinator.com/companies?batch=W24&industry=B2B), individual company URLs (https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/airbnb), or a mix. Leave empty to use the guided filters below — or to scrape the full unfiltered directory if no filters are set.

searchQuery.title: Search Query
searchQuery.description: Optional free-text search across the YC directory (matches the search box on ycombinator.com/companies). Combines with the filters below.

batches.title: YC Batches
batches.description: Funding cohorts to include. Multi-select. Leave empty to include all batches.

status.title: Company Status
status.description: Operating status. Multi-select. Leave empty for all statuses.

regions.title: Regions
regions.description: Headquarters region. Multi-select. Leave empty for all regions.

industries.title: Industries
industries.description: Industry vertical. Multi-select. Leave empty for all industries.

teamSize.title: Team Size
teamSize.description: Self-reported employee count. Multi-select. Leave empty for any size.

isHiring.title: Hiring Only
isHiring.description: If on, return only companies with at least one open job listed on YC. Useful for recruiting and lead generation.

includeFounders.title: Include Founders
includeFounders.description: Embed each company's founders on the result row — name, title, bio, LinkedIn, and X. Disable for faster, cheaper runs that return only company-level data. (Note: Y Combinator does not publish founder emails publicly — `email` and `emailStatus` are always null.)

includeJobs.title: Include Open Jobs
includeJobs.description: Embed each company's open job listings on the result row — title, location, remote, salary, equity, required skills, years of experience, and visa sponsorship. Disable when you only need company and founder data. (Tip: turn off both Founders and Jobs for the fastest, cheapest runs — only company-level fields are returned.)

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Hard cap on total company rows. Default 100 — increase for bigger runs, or set to 0 for no cap (an internal upper limit of 10,000 still applies to prevent runaway pagination). The actor stops requesting new pages once this number is reached but keeps the full final page even if it slightly overshoots.
